headline: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz removed the Jhelum deputy commissioner on Sunday after Intermediate computer science papers in Jhelum were postponed on his recommendation because of her Nov 10 visit, and said the exams will be held on the original schedule, Tuesday Nov 10, Dawn reports.

card.desc: CM Maryam Nawaz ne paper mulatvi karne par DC ko hataya

caption:
Jhelum mein Inter ke paper ab 10 November ko hi honge!
Dawn ke mutabiq Punjab CM Maryam Nawaz ne Sunday ko Jhelum ke deputy commissioner ko ohde se hata diya, jin ki sifarish par BISE Rawalpindi ne CM ke 10 November ke dauray ki wajah se Intermediate computer science ke paper mulatvi kiye the. CM ne kaha ke imtihanaat asal schedule ke mutabiq Tuesday, 10 November ko hi honge.
Kya aap ke ghar mein bhi koi Inter ka student hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
